name: depth-offset-forward-hybrid-variants
purpose: Create synthetic Eevee materials that combine linked Material Output Depth Offset with Shader To RGB hybrid rendering and BLENDED forward rendering, then verify both variants compile and render visible output.
passCriteria: The hybrid material must contain Shader To RGB plus a linked Depth Offset input and render a green center region. The forward material must use BLENDED surface rendering plus a linked Depth Offset input and render a green center region. Both renders must complete without shader create-info or gl_FragDepth compilation errors.
